name: Sandra
source:
Sandra is an amazonian police woman in Gilford. 

She is extremely tall, the protagonist at one point estimates her to be "over 7 feet tall" (>213 cm), which is giant for anyone but especially a woman! She is also exceptionally strong, at one point lifting the protagonist off the ground with one hand! (And she wasn't lifting him from prone either, she grabbed his hands while he was in the "hands up"-position and lifted him clean off his feet! With one hand.) Adding to her amazonian appeal are her huge and firm breasts. (The MC at one point thinks: "She could crush my head like a coconut with those things!")

She is sexually very dominant and expects total submission from the MC (and gets it). She refers to him as her little "pet" instead of his name.
